info.title: Danoffice IT Business Central CLI
info.description: Danoffice IT Business Central helper CLI: git workflow helpers and other BC project tooling.

commands.name: config
commands.description: Manage local CLI configuration (Jira, GitHub, etc)

commands.name: create-integration-branch
commands.description: Create an integration branch from a feature branch and merge in a target branch

options.name: --prefix
options.description: Prefix for the integration branch name. Defaults to 'test-'

options.name: --target
options.description:
Branch to merge into the integration branch. If omitted,
you'll be prompted to pick one

arguments.name: FEATURE_BRANCH
arguments.description:
The feature branch to base the integration branch on. If
omitted, you'll be prompted to pick one

commands.name: new-branch
commands.description:
Create a feat/fix/refactor/etc branch from main, optionally naming it from a
Jira issue

options.name: --type
options.description:
Conventional commit type: feat, fix, refactor, docs,
chore, test, build, ci, perf, style. Prompted if
omitted

options.name: --jira
options.description:
Jira issue key, e.g. DOIT-123. If set and Jira is
configured, the title is pulled automatically

options.name: --description
options.description:
Short description, used if no Jira key is given (or
Jira lookup is skipped)

options.name: --base
options.description:
Branch to create the new branch from. Defaults to
'main'
